Marcos Jr.’s directive to strengthen healthcare access in communities, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) on Thursday turned over ₱22.65 million worth of medical equipment to the provincial government of Batangas, building on its continuing healthcare support for the province.
